standing: pathos-typing: what counts as mattering, for whom — discloses whose stake the claim is; never a gate, never a grade; reasoning (logos) is untouched by this print
work: Sahih al-Bukhari (صحيح البخاري), Kitab al-Adhan — al-Bukhari's own note, in his authorial voice ("Abu 'Abdillah said"), naming the additional narrators (Sa'id ibn Masruq, Mis'ar, al-Shaybani) who corroborated a hadith's transmission from al-Aswad ibn Qays through an independent chain (a mutaba'a)

protocol.null: the text's own term population at the same frequency (the power-of-two count bin is the neighborhood); the floor is the MAX over seeded draws from the bin WITHOUT the term itself (leave-one-out) — the elenchus measured-floor idiom, and the house's standing 'the null is the caller's own distribution'
protocol.stability: two independent seed arms; the prior is the intersection; the drops are recorded as the dissent

entities.why: script has no case (no proper-noun layer by construction)

kindInduction.why: the basin organ (kernel/entity-kind-induction.js) needs entity features this recipe does not fabricate
kindInduction.control: feed this recipe's entity records as entityFeatures into induceEntityKindCandidates; stable basins become the kind print — until then, kinds are a named gap

falsifyingControl: a term in `terms` whose byte span does not contain the term at that address; a recipe rerun that does not reproduce byte-identical output; two same-source-independent archons whose term sets overlap at Jaccard >= 0.5; or a second-seed arm that drops every admission — any of these breaks the print.
